prompt: This blood pressure drug commonly used to treat gestational hypertension was patented the same year the first black student at the University of Mississippi was shot.
answer: The drug is **labetalol**. It was patented in **1966**, the year civil-rights activist **James Meredith**, the first Black student to enroll at the University of Mississippi, was shot during the March Against Fear. Labetalol is commonly used to manage hypertension during pregnancy, including gestational hypertension.
